questions.q: What is 35% of 240?
45 is what percent of 180?
A number 80 is increased by 25%. The new number is:
questions.e: 25% of 80 = 20, so the new number is 80 + 20 = 100.

questions.q: A number when increased by 20% becomes 156. The number is:
questions.e: If the number is x, then 1.2x = 156, so x = 156 ÷ 1.2 = 130. Subtracting 20% of 156 would give a wrong answer.

questions.q: 3/8 expressed as a percentage is:
What is 12½% of 640?
A student scored 360 marks out of 450. The percentage of marks is:
The price of sugar rises by 25%. By what percent must a family cut its consumption so that its expenditure stays the same?
questions.e: New price is 5/4 of old, so consumption must become 4/5, a cut of 1/5 = 20%. Reducing by 25% is the common slip.

questions.q: The population of a town is 50,000. It increases by 10% in a year. The new population is:
questions.e: 10% of 50,000 = 5,000, so the new population is 55,000.

questions.q: The price of an article is raised by 20% and then by 10%. The net increase is:
questions.e: Net factor = 1.2 × 1.1 = 1.32, i.e. 32%. Simply adding 20 + 10 forgets the 2% on the earlier rise.

questions.q: A quantity is first increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. The net change is:
questions.e: Net factor = 1.2 × 0.8 = 0.96, which is a 4% decrease.

questions.q: In an election between two candidates, the winner gets 55% of the votes and wins by 1200 votes. The total number of votes polled is:
questions.e: Winner − loser = 55% − 45% = 10% of the total, so 10% = 1200 and the total is 12000.

questions.q: A town's population is 40,000. It grows 10% in the first year and 20% in the second. The population after two years is:
In an examination, 70% of the candidates passed Mathematics, 80% passed English and 10% failed in both. The percentage who passed both subjects is:
If 30% of x equals 45% of y, then x is what percent of y?
A student scoring 220 marks fails by 20 marks. If the pass mark is 40% of the maximum, the maximum marks are:
questions.e: Pass mark = 220 + 20 = 240, which is 40% of the maximum. So maximum = 240 ÷ 0.4 = 600.

questions.q: A number is increased by 20%, the result is decreased by 25%, and that result is increased by 10%. The net effect on the original number is:
questions.e: Factor = 1.2 × 0.75 × 1.1 = 0.99, so the number falls by 1%.

questions.q: In a two-candidate election, 10% of the votes cast were invalid. The winner got 60% of the valid votes and won by 2160 votes. The total number of votes cast was:
questions.e: Margin = 60% − 40% = 20% of valid votes = 2160, so valid votes = 10800. This is 90% of the votes cast, so total = 10800 ÷ 0.9 = 12000.

questions.q: The population of a town rose by 25% two years ago and by 20% last year, and is now 54,000. What was it three years ago?
A man saves 20% of his income. His income rises by 25% and his expenditure rises by 10%. The percentage increase in his savings is:
questions.e: Take income 100: expenditure 80, savings 20. Now income 125, expenditure 88, savings 37. Increase = 17/20 × 100 = 85%.
